question.text: A test consists of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn></math> multiple choice questions, each having <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn></math> alternative answers of which only one is correct. The number of ways, in which a candidate answers all six questions such that exactly four of the answers are correct, is ___________

solution.text:
No. of ways of giving wrong answer =3

So, required no. of ways =C46(1)4×(3)2
=15(9)=135
